abilities.label: Site Information
abilities.description: Get general site data: name, URL, description, language, timezone, and WordPress version.

abilities.label: User Information
abilities.description: Get the current user's name, email, role, and avatar.

abilities.label: Environment Information
abilities.description: Get technical details: PHP version, database server, and environment type.

abilities.label: Get Posts
abilities.description: List posts filtered by status, category, count, and order.

abilities.label: Get Single Post
abilities.description: Get full post detail by ID, including content, meta data, and featured image.

abilities.label: Get Categories
abilities.description: List all categories with ID, name, slug, and post count.

abilities.label: Get Tags
abilities.description: List all tags with ID, name, slug, and post count.

abilities.label: Get Pages
abilities.description: List site pages with title, status, and hierarchy.

abilities.label: Get Single Page
abilities.description: Get full page detail by ID, including content, template, hierarchy, and SEO metadata.

abilities.label: Get Comments
abilities.description: List comments filtered by status, post, and count.

abilities.label: Get Media
abilities.description: List media library files, optionally filtered by type.

abilities.label: Get Users
abilities.description: List site users with ID, name, email, and role.

abilities.label: Create Post
abilities.description: Create a post with title, content, categories, tags, and featured image.

abilities.label: Update Post
abilities.description: Modify an existing post, updating only the fields you provide.

abilities.label: Delete Post
abilities.description: Send a post to the trash or permanently delete it.

abilities.label: Create Category
abilities.description: Create a category with name, slug, description, and parent.

abilities.label: Create Tag
abilities.description: Create a tag with name, slug, and description.

abilities.label: Create Page
abilities.description: Create a page with title, content, status, and parent page.

abilities.label: Moderate Comment
abilities.description: Change a comment's status to approved, held, spam, or trash.

abilities.label: Reply to Comment
abilities.description: Reply to an existing comment as the authenticated user.

abilities.label: Update Comment
abilities.description: Update the content, author name, email, or linked user of a comment.

abilities.label: Upload Image from URL
abilities.description: Download an image from a URL into the media library and return its attachment ID.

abilities.label: Duplicate Post / Page / CPT
abilities.description: Copy any post, page, or CPT item with its meta and terms. Saved as a draft by default.

abilities.label: Assign Post Terms
abilities.description: Assign custom taxonomy terms to a post or page.

abilities.label: Get Rank Math Metadata
abilities.description: Read a post's Rank Math title, description, keywords, robots, and Open Graph data.

abilities.label: Update Rank Math SEO / Focus Keyword
abilities.description: Update focus keyword, SEO title, description, canonical, robots, and Open Graph via Rank Math.

abilities.label: Update Rank Math Schema
abilities.description: Write a structured-data schema (FAQPage, Article, Product) that renders as JSON-LD.

abilities.label: Get SEOPress Metadata
abilities.description: Read a post's SEOPress title, description, focus keyword, robots, canonical, and social data.

abilities.label: Update SEOPress Metadata
abilities.description: Update SEOPress title, description, focus keyword, canonical, robots, and social fields.

abilities.label: Get SEOPress Content Analysis
abilities.description: Read SEOPress content analysis checks and recommendations, optionally after a fresh run.

abilities.label: Get Yoast SEO Metadata
abilities.description: Read a post's Yoast title, description, focus keyphrase, canonical, robots, and social data.

abilities.label: Update Yoast SEO Metadata
abilities.description: Update Yoast title, description, focus keyphrase, canonical, robots, and social fields.

abilities.label: Get Yoast Sitemap Index
abilities.description: Fetch and parse the Yoast sitemap index into a list of all registered sitemap URLs.

abilities.label: Create Menu
abilities.description: Create a new, empty navigation menu with the given name.

abilities.label: List Menus
abilities.description: List every menu with ID, slug, item count, and the menu shown in each theme location.

abilities.label: Get Menu
abilities.description: Get every item of a menu with its hierarchy, destination, and position.

abilities.label: Add Menu Item
abilities.description: Add a page, post, category, tag, or custom URL to a menu, with optional parent and position.

abilities.label: Update Menu Item
abilities.description: Update the title, custom URL, parent, or position of a menu item.

abilities.label: Remove Menu Item
abilities.description: Permanently remove one item from a menu. Off by default.

abilities.label: Assign Menu Location
abilities.description: Assign a menu to a theme location, changing site-wide navigation. Off by default.

abilities.label: Delete Menu
abilities.description: Permanently delete a menu and all of its items. Off by default.

abilities.label: Search and Replace
abilities.description: Find text in a post's content and replace it with other text.

abilities.label: Site Statistics
abilities.description: Get a site summary: total posts, pages, categories, tags, comments, and users.

abilities.label: Update Post Meta
abilities.description: Write any post meta field by exact key, subject to edit permission on the post.

abilities.label: Get Post Meta
abilities.description: Read a single post meta field by exact key, including whether the key exists.

abilities.label: Get Active Plugins
abilities.description: List active plugins with name, version, and detected capabilities such as SEO or WooCommerce.

abilities.label: Clear Cache
abilities.description: Purge the page cache for one post or the whole site across popular cache plugins.

abilities.label: Create Code Snippet
abilities.description: Create an inactive PHP snippet after syntax validation and a dangerous-function check.

abilities.label: List Code Snippets
abilities.description: List snippets with name, type, scope, active state, and tags, without the code.

abilities.label: Get Code Snippet
abilities.description: Read one snippet by ID, including its code.

abilities.label: Update Code Snippet
abilities.description: Change a snippet's name, description, code, scope, or tags. Off by default.

abilities.label: Set Code Snippet Active
abilities.description: Deactivate a snippet or request activation, which an admin must confirm. Off by default.

abilities.label: List Languages
abilities.description: List the languages available from Polylang, WPML, or Linguator AI.

abilities.label: Create Post Translation
abilities.description: Create a post's translation in a target language and link it to the source.

abilities.label: Set Post Language
abilities.description: Assign a language code to an existing post.

abilities.label: Link Post Translation
abilities.description: Link two posts as translations of each other in one translation group.

abilities.label: Get Post Translations
abilities.description: Get a post's translation map: language, ID, title, permalink, and status.

abilities.label: Create Term Translation
abilities.description: Create the translation of a category, tag, or custom term and link it to the source.

abilities.label: Set Term Language
abilities.description: Assign a language code to an existing taxonomy term.

abilities.label: Link Term Translation
abilities.description: Link two taxonomy terms as translations of each other.

abilities.label: Get Term Translations
abilities.description: Get a term's translation map: language, ID, name, slug, count, and archive URL.

abilities.label: Get Products
abilities.description: List products with price, SKU, stock status, categories, and type, with search and category filters.

abilities.label: Get Single Product
abilities.description: Get full product detail: price, stock, description, gallery, attributes, and variations.

abilities.label: Update Product
abilities.description: Update a product's price, sale price, stock quantity, status, or description.

abilities.label: Get Orders
abilities.description: List orders with customer, total, status, and date, filterable by status. HPOS-compatible.

abilities.label: Get Single Order
abilities.description: Get full order detail: line items, billing and shipping, totals, status history, and notes.

abilities.label: Update Order Status
abilities.description: Change an order's status, for example processing to completed, with an optional note.

abilities.label: Get Customers
abilities.description: List customers with email, name, total spent, and order count. Searchable by email or name.

abilities.label: Get Events
abilities.description: List events with dates, venue, and organizer, filterable by upcoming, past, or date range.

abilities.label: Get Single Event
abilities.description: Get full event detail with resolved venue address and organizer contact info.

abilities.label: Create Event
abilities.description: Create an event with title, description, dates, timezone, and venue by ID or name.

abilities.label: Update Event
abilities.description: Update an event's title, description, dates, timezone, or venue.

abilities.label: List Post Types
abilities.description: List public custom post types with labels, taxonomies, supported features, and capabilities.

abilities.label: Get CPT Items
abilities.description: List items from any custom post type, filtered by status, count, order, and search.

abilities.label: Get Single CPT Item
abilities.description: Get a CPT item by ID with content, meta data, taxonomies, and featured image.

abilities.label: Create CPT Item
abilities.description: Create an item in any custom post type with title, content, status, taxonomies, and image.

abilities.label: Update CPT Item
abilities.description: Update a CPT item, changing only the fields you provide.

abilities.label: Delete CPT Item
abilities.description: Send a CPT item to the trash or permanently delete it.

abilities.label: Get CPT Taxonomies
abilities.description: List a custom post type's taxonomies and their terms.

abilities.label: Assign Terms to CPT Item
abilities.description: Assign taxonomy terms to a CPT item, adding to or replacing existing terms.

abilities.label: Get Term Meta
abilities.description: Read one term meta field by exact key, or all meta for a term.

abilities.label: Update Term Meta
abilities.description: Write any term meta field by exact key.

abilities.label: Update Term
abilities.description: Update a taxonomy term's name, slug, description, or parent.

abilities.label: List Options Pages
abilities.description: List registered JetEngine Options Pages with their field schema, without values.

abilities.label: Get Options Page
abilities.description: Get all fields and current stored values for an Options Page slug.

abilities.label: Update Options Page Field
abilities.description: Write a new value to one field of an Options Page. Off by default.

abilities.label: List Queries
abilities.description: List all Query Builder queries with ID, name, and query type.

abilities.label: Get Query
abilities.description: Get the full settings of one Query Builder query by ID.

abilities.label: Update Query
abilities.description: Update an existing query's name, type, or arguments. Off by default.

abilities.label: Bind Dynamic Field
abilities.description: Bind an Elementor widget setting to a dynamic tag such as post title or a meta field. Off by default.

abilities.label: Get Structure
abilities.description: Read a compact tree of an Elementor page: element IDs, types, and text previews.

abilities.label: Update Element
abilities.description: Edit the static content and style settings of an Elementor element by ID. Off by default.

abilities.label: Get Courses
abilities.description: List published courses with title, slug, permalink, and enrolled user count.

abilities.label: Get Single Course
abilities.description: Get full course detail: description, ordered lessons with topics, and course-level quizzes.

abilities.label: Get User Progress
abilities.description: Get a user's progress in a course: enrollment, steps completed, percentage, and completion.

abilities.label: Get Quiz Results
abilities.description: Get a user's quiz attempts with score, pass/fail, and timestamp, newest first.

abilities.label: Enroll User
abilities.description: Enroll a user in a LearnDash course. Requires admin rights. Off by default.

abilities.label: Unenroll User
abilities.description: Remove a user's access to a LearnDash course. Requires admin rights. Off by default.

abilities.label: Get Lesson Video
abilities.description: Read a lesson's video source configuration: source type, value, and runtime.

abilities.label: Update Lesson Video
abilities.description: Set a lesson's video source using Tutor's own storage function.

abilities.label: List Courses
abilities.description: List published courses with title, slug, permalink, and enrolled user count.

abilities.label: Get Single Course
abilities.description: Get full course detail with topics and their ordered lessons, quizzes, and assignments.

abilities.label: Get User Progress
abilities.description: Get a user's progress in a course: enrollment date, steps completed, and percentage.

abilities.label: Get Quiz Results
abilities.description: Get a user's quiz attempts with score, pass/fail, and timestamps, newest first.

abilities.label: Enroll User
abilities.description: Enroll a user in a Tutor LMS course. Requires admin rights. Off by default.

abilities.label: Unenroll User
abilities.description: Cancel a user's enrollment in a Tutor LMS course. Requires admin rights. Off by default.

abilities.label: Get llms.txt
abilities.description: Fetch the site's llms.txt, detect what serves it, and validate it against the llmstxt.org spec.

abilities.label: Update llms.txt
abilities.description: Write the llms.txt content, via SEOPress Pro when active or a virtual file. Off by default.

abilities.label: Get Accessibility Snapshot
abilities.description: Scan the media library for images missing alt text (WCAG 1.1.1), with pagination.

abilities.label: List Templates
abilities.description: List the active theme's block templates and template parts, marking user-edited overrides.

abilities.label: Get Template
abilities.description: Get the full block markup of one template or template part by slug.

abilities.label: Update Template
abilities.description: Write new block markup to a template or part. Header and footer edits affect every page. Off by default.
